intro1: ALPHA-EL Inc. is a First Nations owned and operated AI and machine learning Consulting Company, that is interested in working in different geographic regions in Canada. Working remotely in Ottawa. Available to go on-site in Whitehorse when requested.
intro2: I am the Chief Technology Officer at Alpha-El, focused on CORAX VISION: A Geo-intelligence Optical AI Surveillance Capability System.
details: Website and mobile Web App (Full Stack) development: React, Vite, Zustand, Express, PostgreSQL.
Training and implementing a neural network (YOLO frameworks) to detect wildlife, fire, and smoke.
Built custom modules for runtime features that integrate with the camera.
Supervised interns assisting with an automated script for trail camera footage and experiments such as fire simulations.
Using Docker containers for each service and integrating all software system components.
Listening to client needs and implementing new features in Python and the full stack web application, including data science tools.
Integrating appropriate AWS services (EC2, S3, Kinesis Video) for data/video/assets storage and reliability.
Platform-agnostic philosophy utilizing hardware acceleration: NVIDIA Jetson edge devices (ARM64). Docker containers ensure code runs on both x64 and ARM architectures.
